fact: A staker transfers USDe into the StakedUSDe contract and receives sUSDe, an ERC4626 vault token. Over time more USDe is transferred in as rewards, and unstaking returns a share of the contract's USDe in proportion to the sUSDe outstanding
Reward payments into the contract occur every 8 hours and vest linearly over 8 hours, so the USDe value of sUSDe can only increase or stay flat
Rewards come from the protocol's revenue from staked Ethereum and from the funding and basis spread on its hedges, which can vary day to day, and in some periods no rewards may be paid
USDe itself does not earn rewards. A holder has to stake it to receive them
Unstaking has a cooldown. The USDe waits in the USDeSilo contract until the cooldown has elapsed, and sUSDe can be sold before then only where an outside market exists
The acquisition of sUSDe is not offered to persons with their habitual residence or registered office in the European Union or the European Economic Area
The sUSDe token contract and the staking contract on Ethereum mainnet are both 0x9d39a5de30e57443bff2a8307a4256c8797a3497
Eligible Balances are supported assets in the account that are not pledged, frozen or under a hold, and within minimum and maximum thresholds, which the pages do not give
The user's tier is shown in the app's enrollment details. The Pricing page and FAQ do not say how a user becomes Pro or VIP
Per-user, per-household, per-device and aggregate program caps might apply
